prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1400; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the shoulder complaints documented at intake. Over the course of fifteen visits, treatment included physical therapy, manual therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication. Care continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, and progress was gradual. Examination revealed positive impingement signs and reduced active abduction, which support the diagnosis of a soft tissue injury to the rotator cuff region. Other testing, including neurological screening and strength measures in the distal extremity, returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the same shoulder. Billing records show two similar charges on the same date of service, which are currently under review. Prognosis is guarded but improving, and further evaluation will be scheduled if symptoms persist.
